title: Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25K Blueberry Raspberry Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Blueberry Raspberry balances ripe Blueberry sweetness with the tart lift of Raspberry for a clean, well-rounded berry mix. The pairing offers an easy, fruit-forward taste that remains clear and consistent throughout. Designed for use with the Hayati Ultra 25K Prefilled Pod Kit, this format pairs a 2ml prefilled pod with two 10ml auto-refilling containers. The device feeds the pod automatically from your selected refill, keeping upkeep simple and mess free. The integrated mesh coil and 20mg Nic Salt ensure steady MTL vapour, reliable flavour and rapid nicotine relief. How to Set Up Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25K Pods Step 1 Remove all protective seals from the 2ml pod and both 10ml refill containers. Step 2 Click the 2ml pod into the mouthpiece module. Step 3 Align and click up to two 10ml auto-refilling containers into the mouthpiece. Step 4 Insert the assembled unit into the device. Step 5 Allow a short moment for the coil to saturate before vaping. ✅ You're all set!
